title: [Shopify] Surface skipped records and sent JSONL for bulk price sync
summary: Shopify bulk price sync now creates skipped records with error details when variants fail on Shopify, and stores sent JSONL data on bulk operations when logging is enabled for troubleshooting.
key_points: Failed variants in bulk price sync now generate Shopify Skipped Records with Shopify error messages instead of silently reverting
Skipped records reference the linked BC Item Variant or Item to show users exactly which product failed and why
Sent JSONL payload is stored on bulk operation records when Logging Mode is set to All for troubleshooting
Download Sent Data action added to Shopify Bulk Operations page to retrieve the stored request JSONL
New Sent JSONL field with helper methods added to Shopify Bulk Operation table
quote: Every reverted variant gets a Shopify Skipped Record with the Shopify error message.
